The '''Ventooine system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ventooine/Legends|Ventooine]].
